source_text: For example, a cohort study in Kericho, Kenya, found that circumcised men had an adjusted hazard ratio of 0.32 (95% CI 0.15–0.68) for HIV acquisition, equivalent to a two-thirds risk reduction after controlling for confounders. [1]
